Job Description
 We are looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our team of bright thinkers and doers. You’ll use your problem-solving creativity to figure out our client’s most complex and challenging problems across different industries. You should be insightful, inquisitive, and naturally collaborative, with a strong desire to share ideas and opinions.
 Responsibilities
Work with business stakeholders & functional teams, fulfilling their data needs and helping them to leverage analytics to improve their domains and act faster, and make better decisions
Assisting our clients in determining how to measure and analyze the effectiveness of their business
Consult clients to shape and define the role and success of analytics in their business
Design and develop reports/dashboards using various analytics and visualization tools
Continually optimizing existing reports/dashboards to improve performance benchmarking
Prepare and publish weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad-hoc reports/dashboards
Engage with relevant stakeholders and provide analysis, reporting and presentations to effectively communicate on insights and KPIs
Identifies and resolves any data quality issues by conducting both routine and ad-hoc data cleaning and testing
Using various tools to identify, analyze, and interpret patterns and trends in complex data sets
Coaching and supporting key users to adopt the reporting tool.
 Qualifications:
Demonstrated ability to work closely with business partners, understand requirements, and provide accurate findings of analysis
Strong working knowledge of data visualization tools such as Power BI (preferably), Tableau or Qlik
Ability to analyze large datasets
Great analytical skills, self-driven and an eye for detail and quality
Solid SQL, Power (M) Query, DAX, Data Visualization
Experience with one or multiple cloud data stores - Databricks / Fabric / Snowflake / GCP / AWS and DWH concepts
Good stakeholder management skills
Good team and business communication skills, including presentation and facilitation skills, and strong attention to detail; can walk through approach with technical clients or explain tricky concepts to non-technical audiences
Experience with agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira or similar).
 Set yourself apart with:
R and/or Python experience
Google Analytics / Mipxanel / Amplitude / Adobe Analytics
A/B testing
Data Governance experience
Martech experience
Financial reporting
 Additional Information
 Besides an exciting job, here s what you can expect:
A fast-paced tech environment
Continuous growth & learning
Open feedback culture
Room for own initiative & ideas
Transparency about results & strategy
Recognition & reward for hard work
Working with a flexible schedule 
Medical subscription
Meal tickets
Extra vacation days
Many other perks 
 Company Description
 Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner supporting established organizations in achieving a future, digitally enabled state, both in how they operate and how they deliver value to their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset combined with modern, proven methods. Our approach integrates strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and creative problem-solving to deliver measurable business outcomes. Guided by our core values and our purpose, helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of what’s next—our global team of more than 20,000 professionals across 53 offices brings together expertise in technology, data science, consulting, and customer-centricity. By combining these capabilities, we enable our clients to accelerate their businesses through the design and delivery of products and services that their customers truly value.
